criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Flags expanded field of use adding 'predictive analytics'
criteria_results.reasoning: D-4 and IV.1 identify that EL §4.1 adds 'predictive analytics applications' to the field, which the TS limited to data infrastructure and edge computing with supply chain optimization expressly excluded.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Notes overlap with Stellarion's core business
criteria_results.reasoning: IV.1 explains that supply chain optimization is itself a predictive analytics application and Stellarion's core market, so the addition opens Stellarion's core market to Helix using Stellarion's own technology.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Flags renewal periods changed from 2-year to 3-year
criteria_results.reasoning: D-9 identifies the change from two 2-year renewals to two 3-year renewals.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes extended maximum license duration (9 vs 11 years)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-9 and Part VI state the maximum term goes from 9 to 11 years (+2 years at 2025 economics).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Flags non-renewal notice period reduced from 180 to 120 days
criteria_results.reasoning: D-9 identifies the non-renewal notice cut from 180 to 120 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Flags restructured upfront payment schedule
criteria_results.reasoning: D-10 correctly states $7.5M/$5.0M under the TS vs $6.25M/$6.25M under the EL.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes cash flow impact of deferred payment to Stellarion
criteria_results.reasoning: D-10 and Part VI note that $1,250,000 is deferred to the six-month installment, which raises credit exposure and has a time-value cost (about $48K).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Flags royalty base changed from Net Revenue to Gross Revenue
criteria_results.reasoning: D-12 identifies the royalty base changing from Net Revenue to Gross Revenue.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags reduced minimum annual royalty ($3M to $2.5M)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-15 identifies the minimum annual royalty cut from $3,000,000 to $2,500,000, i.e. $500,000 less per year.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Flags royalty floor reconciliation period extended (30 to 60 days)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-16 identifies the shortfall payment window extended from 30 to 60 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Flags audit underpayment threshold doubled (5% to 10%)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-17 identifies the audit cost-shifting threshold raised from 5% to 10%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Flags co-development cost split changed from 60/40 to 55/45
criteria_results.reasoning: D-21 identifies the change from 60/40 to 55/45, which increases Stellarion's share.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Notes dollar impact of cost shift ($410,000 to Stellarion)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-21 and Part VI quantify a $410,000 shift ($3,280,000 to $3,690,000 on an $8.2M budget).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Flags omission of sublicense restriction on joint IP
criteria_results.reasoning: D-24 and IV.2 identify that the prior written consent requirement for sublicensing Joint IP is omitted.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes risk of unrestricted sublicensing of joint IP
criteria_results.reasoning: IV.2 discusses Helix freely licensing Meridian IP to third parties, including Stellarion competitors, while Stellarion funds 45% of development.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Flags non-compete tail shortened from 18 to 12 months
criteria_results.reasoning: D-29 identifies the non-compete tail cut from 18 to 12 months.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Flags exclusivity period shortened from 24 to 18 months
criteria_results.reasoning: D-32 identifies exclusivity shortened from 24 to 18 months.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Flags MFN clause entirely omitted
criteria_results.reasoning: D-34 and IV.3 identify that the TS §9 MFN is omitted entirely and describe its terms.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Flags liability cap reduced from $25M to $20M
criteria_results.reasoning: D-36 identifies the cap reduced from $25M to $20M.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Flags changed exclusions from liability cap (IP indemnification added)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-35 identifies that the EL carves indemnification out of the cap, reversing the TS's express inclusion within the cap, and that this creates uncapped exposure.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Flags termination notice period reduced from 60 to 30 days
criteria_results.reasoning: D-43 identifies the notice cut from 60 to 30 days with a 30-day cure and the TS 90-day total. It computes the new total as about 30 days (concurrent reading) rather than 60, but the deviation itself is clearly identified.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Flags confidentiality survival shortened from 3 to 2 years
criteria_results.reasoning: D-40 identifies confidentiality survival cut from 3 to 2 years.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Flags missing source code escrow release trigger (material uncured breach)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-48 identifies deletion of the uncured material breach trigger while bankruptcy and discontinuation triggers remain.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_018: Flags definitive agreement target date extended (May 15 to May 30)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-3 identifies the target date moved from May 15 to May 30, 2025.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_019: Discusses interplay/compounding effect of multiple weakened protections
criteria_results.reasoning: IV.1 'Interaction with other deviations' and IV.3 discuss how multiple changes (field expansion, Joint IP, non-compete weakening, assignment, damages waiver) compound the risk.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_004: Does not flag total co-development budget as a deviation
criteria_results.reasoning: The report states the $8.2M budget is the same in both documents and does not flag the total as a deviation.

criteria_results.title: Report includes a summary table near the top
criteria_results.reasoning: Part III is a summary deviation table that follows directly after the executive summary.

criteria_results.title: Summary table includes severity ratings
criteria_results.reasoning: The summary table has a Severity column (Dealbreaker/Material/Moderate/Minor) for every item.

criteria_results.title: Summary table includes recommended actions for each deviation
criteria_results.reasoning: The summary table has a Recommended action column (Accept/Reject/Negotiate/Flag) for every item.

criteria_results.title: Report specifically addresses GC email concern: field-of-use restriction
criteria_results.reasoning: Field of use is treated as GC Priority 1 with dealbreaker severity, and the report notes it reverses what Priya secured, a negotiated, final point.

criteria_results.title: Report specifically addresses GC email concern: sublicense restriction on joint IP
criteria_results.reasoning: IV.2 is treated as GC Priority 2 and notes that, as the GC said, Stellarion accepted joint ownership only because of this guardrail. It is rated dealbreaker.

criteria_results.title: Report specifically addresses GC email concern: MFN clause
criteria_results.reasoning: IV.3 ties the MFN to the GC's priority 3 and explains it was part of the consideration package for Helix's non-compete.

criteria_results.title: Each deviation includes term sheet provision and engagement letter provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Every D-item in Part V states both the Term Sheet and Engagement Letter positions.

criteria_results.title: Each deviation includes practical impact on Stellarion
criteria_results.reasoning: Substantially all D-items include an Analysis discussing the practical effect on Stellarion.

criteria_results.title: Each deviation includes a recommended action
criteria_results.reasoning: Every D-item includes a Recommended action / position.

criteria_results.title: Report notes consistent provisions between the two documents
criteria_results.reasoning: The report confirms consistent provisions: the unchanged $12.5M total fee, the unchanged $8.2M budget, preserved Delaware law/JAMS/Wilmington/three arbitrators, the same insolvency triggers and the same royalty rate.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Severity rated Critical or High
criteria_results.reasoning: The field-of-use expansion is rated Dealbreaker, the highest tier.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Discusses combined effect of lower cap AND changed exclusions
criteria_results.reasoning: D-36 discusses the lower cap together with the indemnity carve-out, calling the combination 'doubly adverse'. Part VI pairs them as well.

criteria_results.title: Correct identification of total upfront fee as unchanged ($12.5M)
criteria_results.reasoning: The report states the $12.5M total is unchanged and that only the split moves.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Quantifies potential total impact of reduced minimum royalty
criteria_results.reasoning: D-15 and Part VI quantify a $2.0M reduction over Royalty Years 2-5 and $4.0M over a 9-year term.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Notes practical impact on audit incentive/deterrence
criteria_results.reasoning: D-17 explains the higher threshold weakens the deterrent value of the audit right and allows under-reporting of up to nearly 10% without bearing audit costs.
